title: Concept: MongoDB error detail disclosed in a response
description: A MongoDB driver topology or server-selection error in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The error lists shard hosts, ports and the replica-set shape, which is the topology an attacker needs to target the primary.
applicability: Deployments that render a MongoDB driver topology or server-selection error into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The error lists shard hosts, ports and the replica-set shape, which is the topology an attacker needs to target the primary.
